make_doom_env: create a Doom Gym environment by name using make_doom_env with a config object
make_doom_env_impl: build a singleplayer or multiplayer VizDoom environment instance with wrappers and resolution settings
make_doom_multiplayer_env: create a multi-agent Doom environment with bots and optional human players
doom_env_by_name: look up a DoomSpec configuration object by environment name from the DOOM_ENVS registry
DoomSpec: define a new Doom environment specification with action space, reward scaling, and wrapper settings
